site_tagline: Information about Fullwood milking robots, collected by users
disclaimer_short: Independent site run by users. Not affiliated with Fullwood JOZ.
home_hero_sub: Alongside the Facebook group: common faults, cost items and the Fullwood JOZ channels, collected in one place.

repairs_safety_body: Switch off the mains isolator and release the compressed air before any work on the robot. The information on this page comes from users and does not replace the official documentation or the service department.
